item.title: Warm sunshine rules the forecast until storm system reaches Houston next week
item.description: We are on the front end of a warming trend that will continue through next week. Enjoy the sunshine because unsettled weather returns after the weekend.

item.title: 13-year-old girl killed in NW Houston stabbing; 10-year-old boy claimed self-defense: HPD
item.description: Police say a 10-year-old boy was detained after claiming he stabbed the 13-year-old girl in self-defense during a fight, but was later released.

item.title: 'I'm not giving you an option': GPD credits speedy rescue of kidnapping victim to insistent officer
item.description: Officials are crediting a SWAT officer's persistence for the speedy rescue of a kidnapping and sexual assault victim in Galveston last week.

item.title: Surgeon indicted by the feds for allegedly altering records, making patients ineligible for organs
item.description: The Memorial Hermann physician was allegedly manipulating the criteria of patients on organ transplant waiting lists, according to federal prosecutors.

item.title: Connecticut derailment: Freight train derails, sending cars carrying liquid propane into river
item.description: A freight train derailed Thursday in Connecticut, sending cars carrying flammable liquid propane into the water, though officials say they don't appear to be leaking.

item.title: Sugar Land PD said it changed protocols after teen suspects escaped its jail
item.description: Sugar Land said it made changes to its jail procedures after teen inmates beat a staffer and escaped. However, they were tight-lipped about what happened and their procedures.

item.title: Some eastbound lanes on East Freeway reopen as sinkhole repairs continue
item.description: TxDOT reports that several eastbound lanes on the East Freeway near Federal Road opened on Thursday after significant sinkhole repair progress.

item.title: West Houston shooting sparks safety concerns among community
item.description: Police said two people were in a car when someone opened fire, injuring one of them. Neighbors are now left with worry as HPD works to gather more information.

item.title: Teenager shot and killed in Cloverleaf area, according to HCSO
item.description: The Harris County Sheriff's Office said it is investigating after a teenager was shot and killed in the Cloverleaf area on Uvalde Road.

item.title: Bad Bunny says he will bring his culture to 2026 Super Bowl halftime performance
item.description: Bad Bunny says he's approaching his highly anticipated halftime performance with a mix of excitement, gratitude and perspective.
